title: A document this checker cannot read
description: Trailing comma, deliberately — so JSON.parse refuses it. The verdict the red proof requires is a WARNING that names the file and an exit code of zero, because 'the check could not happen' is a different claim from 'the surface is clean', and collapsing the second into the first is how a green badge ends up standing for an unknown. tests/test_specs.py's meta-validation never reads this: it is not under schemas/.
